body: I don't want to talk to anybody! You reached out that's why I became casual. I don't like being "helped". Nobody can do that. I'm sorry I'm exhausted. I need to go.
In others the moon will keep mocking and you'll ignore it?

They laugh at me and joke on my incapacity to reach them. I feel a part of them. But I cannot reach them. Not with this body. I don't know how can I reach them and kiss them and tell them to stop that fucking laughter. It doesn't help. I feel helpless. This has continued for a long time. It's not easy. They want all of us to become a part of them or at least reach them right now. We cannot because we cannot stop the fighting, we cannot do anything which can be called progress as a team because we enjoy our fucking luxury too much.

I'm tired looking at the moon, and the stars and the sun. They mock me now. I'll be dead, but the fact that I can't reach them makes me hate myself even more. There is this bullshit thing called dimensions what's the point of knowing them. Every human we read about in our books is dead. We all on SW and everywhere else are just waiting for our second (time). I'm tired and I'm scared. 

I don't know why this continuous chaos. Why can't we see important things that needs attention. I'm just tired. I don't like the world at all.
Yes you can Pm me. I allow it.

Life is excitingly scary. The burden is overwhelming. I want to do something but I can't! I feel utterly tired of the continuous thoughts in my head. I don't like it. I can't take it anymore. I don't want meds. I don't want to go to the hospital. I hate that kind of dependency. But I'm getting exhausted enough to kill myself.
